facts.fact: 她整夜没睡等 Jingling 回家，天亮仍不见人影
facts.anchor: Kiamling did not sleep that evening

facts.fact: 她反省自己该等出了旅店再说，并承认妹妹不是把唱戏当爱好
facts.anchor: she took it more seriously than a hobby

facts.fact: 湿货市场买妹妹爱吃的菜，几次认错人；一个人吃冷掉的饭
facts.anchor: Just a trick of her mind.

facts.fact: 她认定妹妹才是藏秘密的一方，故意不听自己也没说实话的念头
facts.anchor: Kiamling conveniently ignored the voice in her head

facts.fact: 她接受 Archie 的赛马邀约：既可打探上层，也想离开空屋子
facts.anchor: The perfect opportunity to snoop within the upper echelons.

facts.fact: 她拒绝穿他带来的洋装，他提醒有约定、还有出场费
跑马地原先是稻田沼泽，为赛马把地填干了
facts.anchor: The area had been swampland, perfect for rice growing

facts.fact: 她以前在马场端酒水、捡赌票
facts.anchor: Kiamling had worked at the racecourse before

facts.fact: Lancaster 打掉她伸向酒杯的手
facts.anchor: Those are for spectators, not staff.

facts.fact: 化妆间里两位欧籍女士帮她穿洋装
facts.anchor: You need to put on the petticoat first.

facts.fact: 她用英语反问：缠足与束腰哪个更糟
facts.anchor: to be bound at the feet or cinched at the waist?

facts.fact: 帮她梳头的女士是总督夫人，还给她起了个洋名 Cora
facts.anchor: My name is Maria. Maria Bowring.

facts.fact: 总督夫人送她一面有两道裂纹的镜子
